THEIA · Reproducible experiment

full_preprocessed_study · seeds [42, 43, 44] · CPU

Full exported training split, not all nodes in the dataset. Validation and test graphs remain held out. Graph-local identities do not establish unique entity disjointness. Presumed-background labels and prior test-set inspection limit benchmark claims.

Data and protocol

  • train: 890,093 node occurrences / 1,546,396 edges; labels {'positive': 0, 'presumed_background': 0, 'unknown': 890093}
  • validation: 389,106 node occurrences / 700,318 edges; labels {'positive': 0, 'presumed_background': 389106, 'unknown': 0}
  • test: 344,767 node occurrences / 628,107 edges; labels {'positive': 25319, 'presumed_background': 319448, 'unknown': 0}

All eligible training nodes used; no benign-only filtering. RF fits all training rows using standard bootstrap trees. MAGIC retains all training embeddings with exact multiplicity compression. One complete graph per neural batch within declared node/edge caps.

Training time includes scaling, optimization, epoch validation, checkpoints and reference construction. Test scoring time excludes graph reads and CSV writing. Peak memory is worker OS high-water RSS, not whole-machine memory.

Per-seed metrics CSV · Mean / sample SD CSV · Prediction audit · Label alignment audit · Graph excerpt records
